Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

munch 0.0.4

New features

  • Markdown text can contain LaTeX equations, as in R Markdown and Quarto: $...$ in the text, $$...$$ alone on its line. A dollar that does not open an equation stays a dollar. Equations need the package ‘equatags’ and R >= 4.3; without them, their LaTeX source is written, with a warning.
  • Markdown text can contain superscripts and subscripts: m^2^, H~2~O.
  • element_md() can be used for all texts of a plot: axis tick labels, labels of colour bars, polar axes, and the whole theme with theme(text = element_md()).
  • default_text_props() has new arguments bold and italic.

Changes

These changes move or resize existing texts slightly.

  • Text is laid out as in Word: words are measured with the kerning of their font, a line has the height of its font (the default line spacing is now 1 instead of 1.2, as in ‘flextable’), superscripts and subscripts are 65% of the font size.
  • lineheight is only applied between lines, as in ‘ggplot2’.
  • Texts follow the ‘ggplot2’ theme: element_chunks() takes its size, font, colour and face for the chunks that do not set them, geom_text_md() and geom_label_md() their default size, font, colour and fill. When the theme has no font family, munch uses the font of flextable::set_flextable_defaults().
  • element_md() and element_chunks() are S7 elements extending ggplot2::element_text(), as the elements of ‘ggplot2’ 4.0. Their arguments do not change; code_font_family and width default to NA (unset).
  • cairo_pdf() gives a warning on Windows, where it draws text without kerning. Use ‘ragg’ instead.

Bug fixes

Texts made with element_md() or element_chunks() are now placed as with element_text():

  • axis titles follow hjust;
  • titles at an angle that is not a right angle (angle = 45) are rotated around their anchor;
  • legend titles and labels are not wrapped: long ones were broken or no longer aligned with their key;
  • left and right margins are counted in the width: legend labels were drawn over the next key;
  • the margin of the labels of polar axes and guide_axis(angle =) are applied;
  • theme(axis.text = element_md()) applies to axis.text.x and axis.text.y.

Other fixes:

  • geom_text_md() with an angle drew the text away from its point.
  • nudge_x and nudge_y were ignored by geom_text_md() and geom_label_md().
  • element_md() ignored its argument face (#4).
  • Wrapped text: right-aligned and centred lines were shifted by their final space, and with width and hjust > 0 texts were shifted to the right.
  • Equations created with flextable::as_equation() were dropped by chunks_grob() and element_chunks().
  • as_paragraph_md() with an image gave a paragraph that ‘flextable’ refused. An image that can not be read is now dropped with a warning.

Dependencies

  • ‘ggplot2’ >= 4.0.4, ‘S7’ and ‘gdtools’ >= 0.6.0 are required.
  • ‘equatags’ >= 0.4.0 is suggested, to draw equations.

munch 0.0.3

CRAN release: 2026-11-10

New features

  • element_md() and element_chunks() have a new argument width to set the maximum width of the text. Use it with ‘patchwork’ or with a fixed aspect ratio to get titles with the right height (see below).

Bug fixes

  • Titles, subtitles and captions made with element_md() or element_chunks() could have their first lines cut at the top of the plot: their height was computed for the width of the plot instead of the width of their column. It is now computed for the width they are drawn with. With ‘patchwork’ or a fixed aspect ratio, this width is not known in advance: set width in these cases.
  • A word wider than the available width no longer overflows: it starts on a new line and, if it is still too wide, it is split between characters (without hyphen). Images, superscripts and subscripts are never split.
  • Consecutive line breaks now give empty lines, and spaces written after a line break are kept.

Changes

  • Text is now arranged into lines by flextable::layout_lines(), so that rich text wraps the same way in ‘munch’ and in ‘flextable’.
  • SVG images are rendered at the size they are drawn, so that they stay sharp.

Performance

  • Lines are arranged faster.
  • An image used several times is decoded only once in a session.
  • The size of ‘png’, ‘jpeg’ and ‘gif’ images is read from their file header, without decoding them: about 15 times faster.

Dependencies

  • ‘munch’ now requires ‘flextable’ >= 0.10.4, ‘officer’ >= 0.7.8 and ‘gdtools’ >= 0.5.3.
  • ‘munch’ now requires ‘ggplot2’ >= 4.0.0.

munch 0.0.2

CRAN release: 2026-04-16

Bug fixes

  • element_md() and element_chunks() no longer ignore plot.tag.position and plot.tag.location (#1).
